knowledge_documents.title: Store Shipping Policy (Web Page)
knowledge_documents.content:
Content extracted from https://shop.example.com/policies/shipping:
Standard return policy allows customers 30 days from delivery to request a refund or exchange. Items must be in original unworn condition with tags attached. Domestic shipping takes 2-4 business days via FedEx Express. Free delivery on all orders over $75. International shipping delivers within 7-10 business days. For cancellations, customers can modify orders within 2 hours of checkout.

knowledge_documents.title: Shipping Policy.pdf
knowledge_documents.content: Orders placed before 2:00 PM EST ship same day. Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days. Express shipping takes 24 hours. Real-time UPS tracking numbers are assigned once dispatched.

knowledge_documents.title: Return Policy.pdf
knowledge_documents.content: We offer a 30-day hassle-free return window for all unblemished hardware and unopened software packages. Full refunds are processed within 48 hours of return receipt.

knowledge_documents.title: Product Catalog.pdf
knowledge_documents.content: MacBook Air M1 ($799) features an 8-core CPU, up to 18 hours battery life, Retina display. Dell Inspiron 15 ($749) features Intel Core i7, 16GB RAM, 512GB SSD with 10 hours battery life.

knowledge_documents.title: Company FAQ.docx
knowledge_documents.content: Demo appointments can be booked 7 days a week between 9:00 AM and 6:00 PM EST. Synced automatically with Google Calendar and Microsoft Outlook.

knowledge_documents.title: Terms & Conditions.pdf
knowledge_documents.content: Multi-tenant enterprise service level agreement guarantees 99.99% monthly uptime and strict encryption-at-rest data privacy.
